objective: Normalize AI-produced Report Design visuals deterministically into scenario-neutral structures supported by the bounded PBIP compiler while preserving the original design, strict APBRA-138 integrity controls and traceable provenance.
requirements: APBRA-139 Normalize AI Report Design to Supported PBIP Visual Contracts
acceptance_criteria: AI-produced Report Design evidence remains distinct from a deterministic compiler-safe normalized design.
Semantically independent supported slicer bindings normalize into deterministic single-binding visuals with stable collision-safe identities and bounded non-overlapping layout order.
Ambiguous, empty, measure-bound or otherwise unsupported visual bindings continue to stop safely under strict APBRA-138 integrity validation.
Normalization actions retain original visual identity, source bindings, resulting identities and reasons in technical trace evidence.
Guardrails and the PBIP compiler receive only the normalized design after deterministic integrity validation.
Production normalization is generic and contains no report, scenario, filename, field, KPI or page special cases.
verification_required: Focused normalization, Foundry, workflow, guardrail and compiler integration tests
Full web test suite and production build
Hosted history-aware secret scan and fresh independent review
Live GPT-4.1 ServiceNow happy-path execution through normalization, guardrails, compilation and deterministic candidate validation
Haseeb Power BI Desktop validation of any newly generated candidate
out_of_scope: Guardrail architecture, PBIP compiler, schema-ingestion, RAG, governed corpus, PDF, styling, dependency, backend, environment or security-model changes
Scenario-specific ServiceNow, Ticket Type, Stage, Sales, report-name, filename, KPI or page logic
Weakening APBRA-138 visual cardinality, measure integrity, cycle detection, reference validation or compiler defence
Silently dropping requested bindings, choosing one ambiguous binding, inventing fields or claiming unsupported Power BI behavior
Production deployment or claiming Power BI Desktop success without Haseeb confirmation
escalate_when: Source contradiction or implementation scope expansion
A required path is outside the exact allowlist
Normalization cannot preserve semantics deterministically or would weaken an APBRA-138 invariant
Live Foundry, build, bootstrap, secret scanning or independent review is unavailable
